title: Smarter WhatsApp assistant
how: In the team group, write: lumina summary (or: lumina summary yesterday / monday / 12 oct). Add a task to someone from Daily Standup and they get a WhatsApp automatically.
bullets: Group summary now comes split by topic with an Important section on top. Days run 3 AM to 3 AM; ask for yesterday, a weekday or a date like 12 oct.
When someone hands you a task from the Daily Standup, you now get a WhatsApp message straight away.
Reminders list your open tasks one per line, so they are easier to read.
The Calendar counts 9 hours or more as a full day.

title: Ask Lumina who logged in, and when
bullets: Ask the Lumina WhatsApp assistant what time anyone logged in or left, today or on any earlier day.
Ask who has logged in and who hasn't, for today or a past day.
Ask for a whole week or month for one person, or compare two people.
Answers come straight from the attendance records, with work from home days and holidays shown.
how: WhatsApp Lumina, for example: what time did Nupur log in today, did Happy log in on Monday, who hasn't logged in, or attendance last week.

title: Reminders and scheduled group posts by WhatsApp
bullets: Tell Lumina to remind you about anything, any day or time, and it WhatsApps you then.
Ask Lumina to post a message in the team group at a time you choose; it asks you to confirm with a yes first.
Say it the way you like: remind me tomorrow, ping me Friday, post this in the group at 5pm.
A plain yes with nothing waiting is no longer taken as a command.
how: Message Lumina on WhatsApp, for example: remind me tomorrow at 10 to call the client, or: post in the group at 5pm that the meeting moved to 6. Tap the i button on the dashboard to see every update.

title: Tasks from the team group, automatically
bullets: When someone asks you to do something in the team group, Lumina now adds it to your Daily Standup and WhatsApps you straight away.
Client feedback mentioned in the group is sent to that client's owner as soon as it is spotted.
Added by mistake? Tell Lumina that wasn't a task and it removes it.
how: Just write the request in the group, for example: Charu make the Omotec reel by Friday. The person gets a WhatsApp and the task shows in their Daily Standup.

title: Links now included in group summaries
bullets: When you ask Lumina to summarise the team group, the links people shared are now included.
Each link sits under the point it belongs to, and any others are listed at the end under Links shared.
how: In the team group write: lumina summary (or: lumina summary yesterday). The links come with it.

title: Recycle bin for your daily standup
bullets: Crossed a task off by mistake? It now goes to a Recycle bin instead of disappearing.
You can bring it back with one tap, any time in the next 30 days.
Tasks from yesterday that were missing from your list now carry over correctly, even if you had already added a task today.
how: Open Daily Standup, tap Recycle bin above your task list, then Restore next to the task.

title: Tasks from the team group now ask you first
bullets: When someone asks you to do something in the team WhatsApp group, Lumina no longer adds it to your standup by itself.
A small card appears in the bottom-right corner of Lumina with the task, who asked and when it is due.
Tap Add to put it on today's Daily Standup, or Reject to drop it. The card stays until you answer, then it goes away.
how: Open any Lumina page, look at the bottom-right corner, then tap Add to my standup or Reject.

title: Tell us your mood each day
bullets: After you log in, a small card asks how you are feeling: awesome, happy, mid, sad or stressed
You pick once a day and it stays on screen until you do
Your mood shows as an emoji next to your name on the Live Attendance board
how: After you check in, tap the emoji in the card at the bottom-right corner of Lumina.

title: See who is on leave in the Calendar
bullets: The Calendar now shows when your teammates are on leave, past, present and upcoming
You see their name and the dates, never the reason
Half days are marked, and only approved leave is shown
how: Open Calendar and look for the pink 'Team on leave' entries. Tap one to see who and when, or untick 'Team on leave' on the left to hide them.

title: Edit a client straight from the Client Portal
bullets: Each client card on the Client Portal now has an Edit client link that opens a box right there
You can change the client name, email, deadline and notes, the client login, add or change their WhatsApp number, and edit or add their tasks without leaving the page
how: Open Client Portal, then tap Edit client under a client's name.

title: Lumina can now sit in a client's WhatsApp group
bullets: Add Lumina to a client's group and it answers only when someone says Lumina
It speaks very formally and politely, with no stickers or greetings
It reads and remembers the group chat, and can tell the client the status of their own deliverables
Anything it cannot answer (changes, approvals, pricing) is passed to the client's account manager
how: Add the Lumina number to the client's group, then type 'Lumina, this is the Omotec group' in it once.

title: See everyone's tasks in one place
bullets: A new Everyone's Tasks page shows each teammate's standup tasks on their own card
Each card shows when they checked in and checked out
Cards with more than 3 tasks have Next and Prev buttons
Search for a teammate by name
how: Open Daily Standup, then tap View everyone's tasks.
